english.title: Manufacturer place energy-related product on market without assessing implementing measure
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a manufacturer,

(A)_[placed on the market]_
(B)_[put into service]_

an energy-related product, namely **(..SPECIFY PRODUCT..),

(C)_[when you had not assessed whether it complied with the applicable implementing measure]_
(D)_[when, having assessed that it complied with the applicable implementing measure, you failed to make a declaration of conformity]_
(E)_[when, having assessed that it complied with the applicable implementing measure, you failed to affix the CE marking visibly, legibly and indelibly to the product, the packaging or documentation that accompanied the product]_
(F)_[when you had not complied with the equivalent provision in **(..SPECIFY STATE..), a member state, to regulation 3(2) of the Ecodesign for Energy-Related Products Regulations 2010 in that **(..SPECIFY PROVISION NOT COMPLIED WITH..) in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
(G)_[when you had not complied with the equivalent provision in **(..SPECIFY STATE..), an EEA state, to regulation 3(2) of the Ecodesign for Energy-Related Products Regulations 2010 in that **(..SPECIFY PROVISION NOT COMPLIED WITH..) in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF COMPLIANCE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 4 and 14 of the Ecodesign for Energy-Related Products Regulations 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a manufacturer
placed on market/put into service an energy related product
when not complying with regulation 3(2)

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 12 of the Ecodesign for Energy-RelatedProducts Regulations 2010 provides that the market surveillance authority may authorise in writing such personswho appear suitable to act on its behalf to carry out any functions and toexercise any power conferred by RAMS, subject to any limitations or conditionsas it sees fit.
(ii) Regulation 19 of the Ecodesign for Energy-RelatedProducts Regulations 2010 provides that the court may (in addition to any other order it may make as to costs orexpenses) order the person convicted to reimburse the market surveillanceauthority for any expenditure which it or any authorised person has reasonablyincurred in investigating the offence, including in purchasing or in testing orexamining any energy-related product, or any part of it, in respect of whichthe offence was committed.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
